description: Shipped catalog. Only Anthropic pricing is included, verified on 2026-10-12 against Anthropic's official pricing pages. IDs/availability/limits are unconfirmed until `modelspend catalog sync`; OpenAI, Google and xAI have no entries yet because their official pages have not been verified. See docs/catalog-verification.md.

models.notes: Pricing verified on 2026-10-12 against Anthropic's official pricing pages (the pricing URL comes from sources.json, so it can be changed with `modelspend sources set anthropic <url>`). The model ID, availability and limits are NOT on those pages: run `modelspend catalog sync` with your key to confirm them from the live Models API. Until then this model is not routable.
models.tier_note: editorial prior from Anthropic's model line (haiku=1, sonnet=2, opus/fable=3); not a measurement

conditions: cache write price is for the 5-minute TTL (1-hour writes cost more)
Batch API (50% discount), US-only inference (1.1x) and fast mode multipliers are not modelled and not used by ModelSpend
server-side tools (e.g. web search) have separate per-use charges and are not used by ModelSpend
prices shown are for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; see long_context_tiers
